species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 57°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 10–44 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 75 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 115 ft, so fish stay above it.
West wind at 15 mph pushes bait onto the east shore: try the wind-blown banks.
